headline: Nobody actually wants a personalised internet.
challenge: Setting aside the word 'every' — do you actually deny that the feeds most people use for hours a day (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Netflix) are individually tuned rather than shared, and that this has reduced common ground between strangers? If not, what exactly are you contesting besides a quantifier?
defence: I've successfully refuted your first attempt. Now for the second. "Most" people don't use Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Netflix every day. The world is a big place and a small minority use these things. How could it possibly reduce common ground to most people if they're not even aware of it.
